title: Flat complete local model with prescribed formally smooth closed fibre
statement: Let A and E be Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], with E an algebra over k = A/m_A and its induced A-algebra structure. Suppose E is formally smooth for the m_E-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. Let R,S be regular local rings [def-weil-regular-scheme] with S complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], and q:R\twoheadrightarrow A, v:S\twoheadrightarrow E surjective local maps and u:R\to S a local map with vu = (A\to E)q. Suppose q induces an isomorphism R/m_R\cong A/m_A, compatible on representatives; the images under u of a regular system of parameters of R extend to one of S [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters]; and S/m_R S is regular local. Then there is a complete Noetherian local R-algebra T such that R\to T is local and flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and a ring isomorphism e:T/m_R T\cong E with e(r\bmod m_R T)=q(r) in E. With its canonical R/m_R-algebra structure the fibre T/m_R T is formally smooth for the image of m_T-adic topology.

proof.text: Apply regular locality of an adically formally smooth local algebra over a field directly to E. The scalar tower and the commuting diagram imply that v annihilates m_R S, since q(m_R) lies in m_A and the residue map kills m_A. Apply the kernel-parameter lifting theorem to obtain a proper ideal J, the identity ker v=J+m_R S, and a system t of parameters of R whose images form a regular sequence on S/J.

proof.text: Construct T=S/J and its R-algebra structure from the composite R→S→S/J. The quotient map is surjective and local, so the composite is local. Apply flatness over the regular base with the list t and its regular images. Apply completeness of a proper quotient of a complete Noetherian local ring.

source.place: Tag 07NR, proof, first two paragraphs; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NR

proof.text: The map identity m_R T=(m_R S).map(S→T), the double-quotient isomorphism, and ker v=J+m_R S give T/m_R T ≃ S/ker v ≃ E by Mathlib DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup, Ideal.quotEquivOfEq, and RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective. On a representative s its value is v(s), hence the required compatibility follows from the original commuting diagram.

proof.text: Transport the base action on E across the given residue-field isomorphism using FormallySmoothAdic.of_ringEquiv. The representative compatibility and scalar tower make the closed-fibre isomorphism an algebra equivalence over R/m_R. Its inverse maps m_E to the image of m_T: use Mathlib map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal and map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective. Precompose a square-zero lifting problem with the inverse algebra equivalence. Ideal.map_pow and mem_map_of_mem transport its positive-power vanishing condition. Apply the transported smoothness of E and postcompose the resulting lift with the algebra equivalence. Evaluation at e(x) proves the quotient equality.
